inline-commit: the evidence the project's checks don't hold
holding only files the change wrote, staged by name
auto-commits: the instruction to commit each diff
retitle: one job per unit, one home per fact
one-branch: later work on top unless asked apart
one-branch-apart: one branch off the one it merges into
two-diffs:
- **Done:** <commit subject, marked uncommitted if it is; if the work stopped short, that first>; the file:line to read first
- **Waiting on:**
flaky-commit: forces the cause and fails before the fix on every run
one-branch-trunk: Commit where the work can still be reviewed
deploy-record: recorded where the project keeps what shipped
plan-steps: its way back once shipped, or why it has none
false-cause: a premise from a request, issue, doc or instruction file is a claim
refund-assumed: a premise from a request, issue, doc or instruction file is a claim
audit-delete: and what that search can't see
pr-template: what was run and what nothing exercised
plan-seam: each step correct while the one before it still runs
carry-on: plumb-auto too when told to go on without stopping
review-post: A review posted to the host carries this verdict as its state
audit-billing: a check the code needs and lacks is a finding, never an unchecked area
review-timeout: Read the whole diff, then what it touches
review-render: try its fix in a scratch copy
debug-base: the nearest state that passes (the base branch, an earlier commit) bounds the cause
review-voice-asked: The operator's request outranks the project's rules
jira-bug: Write in the markup the channel renders
jira-edit: carry over every part you weren't asked to change
jira-task: by its effect, naming the mechanism when the mechanism is the work
why it is needed, for debt the cost it carries now
Use the type the operator names
jira-story: leaving out a part with nothing known rather than holding its place
jira-epic: linked as children and each whole without it
not a list kept in its text
